name: looptube
description: Open-source Firefox extension that adds loop, A-B repeat, speed, sleep timer, volume boost and background play to YouTube

scripts.lint: npm run build && web-ext lint --source-dir dist
scripts.start: npm run build && web-ext run --source-dir dist
scripts.package: npm run build && web-ext build --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir artifacts --overwrite-dest
